OpenCode and Kilo publish the question lifecycle on their daemon event streams. MiMo Code publishes the same shapes on its native event stream. The Worker uses these events to raise and withdraw control requests. The browser uses QuestionAsked to identify the stored payload. Both readers use one vocabulary. These question events never reach the Agent Client Protocol stream for OpenCode or Kilo. Their adapter handles four event types and includes no question. The Worker therefore reads the daemon HTTP event stream. The HTTP routes that carry the answer stay in Go, because the browser never calls them. answerFields lists the two answer-envelope fields that the browser writes and the Worker reads. A Go struct tag cannot contain a constant. TestOpenCodeAnswerTagsMatchTheContract checks the native tags against this table. TestMiMoAnswerTagsMatchTheContract checks the MiMo tags against the same table.

OpenCode and Kilo report output file paths in native truncation metadata. The browser owns those native fields in its provider protocol module. The browser shows each path beside the original preview. LeapMux reads no output file.
